name: Hola
summary: A trick-taking card game where only matching rank or wild 7s and 2s can win, fighting for aces, tens and last trick.
rules_text: Hola uses 52 cards for 2 or 4 players (partners opposite). 7s and 2s are wild. Aces and Tens are 10 points, last trick is 10, total 90. Deal 4 cards each, rest as stock. Non-dealer or left of dealer leads. Any card may be led. Each other player in order plays one card; to be currently winning you must match the original lead rank or play wild, last such player wins. After one round of plays, the original leader may end the trick or fight by leading another card, all others play again. This may repeat up to 4 times until hands empty. Winner collects all cards of the trick and leads next; all players draw from stock to refill to 4. When stock empty, play out hands. Score won Tens/Aces plus last trick. First to agreed total, typically 200-500, wins. Taking all tricks (Hola) scores 170.
